summary: Frontend-only testing of Keystone integration as Smart Investing flagship internal landing /smart-investing. Found and fixed a CRITICAL homepage crash: FeaturedFinancialSection called useKeystoneOnboarding() without importing it (dead code from previous refactor) — caused 'useKeystoneOnboarding is not defined' ReferenceError that broke the entire homepage. After fix, all 24 acceptance criteria verified: SmartInvestingPage renders cinematically (hero, 4 stats, 4 pillars, 3 steps, 3 testimonials, inline form, FAQ, final CTA), all internal SPA Links (header nav, hero pill, hero CTA, footer w/ Flagship badge, mobile nav, FeaturedFinancialSection x3 CTAs) point to /smart-investing (no direct modal/external), redirects from /category/smart-investing and /product/keystone-investors-club work via <Navigate replace> / useNavigate, other 4 categories still load CategoryPage normally, inline-apply-form posts to /api/leads and opens external Keystone in new tab via window.open after confirmation, hero primary and final CTAs open keystone-onboarding modal. Mobile 390x844 renders all sections readably.

ui_bugs.issue: FIXED by testing agent — called useKeystoneOnboarding() without importing it, crashing the entire homepage with 'useKeystoneOnboarding is not defined' ReferenceError. Removed the unused destructure since all CTAs are now <Link> components. Main agent should verify the fix and consider running ESLint no-undef rule to catch this class of bug pre-deploy.

issues: Cinematic dark + gold premium aesthetic confirmed — serif headline, glassy cards, animated pulse dot, blurred gold radial gradients all rendering correctly
Hero, stats grid, pillars, steps, testimonials and inline-apply-form all visible and readable

action_items: VERIFY fix to /app/frontend/src/components/FeaturedFinancialSection.jsx (removed orphan useKeystoneOnboarding call) — homepage was completely broken before this fix.
Consider enabling ESLint no-undef rule in CI to catch missing imports before they reach preview.

Note: featured-financial-secondary-cta href is '/smart-investing#how-it-works' (Link with hash anchor) — this is correct behavior (scrolls to How It Works on flagship page) but worth confirming with PM that hash-scroll is desired vs landing at top.
critical_code_review_comments: FeaturedFinancialSection.jsx was missing import for useKeystoneOnboarding while still calling the hook — dead code from previous refactor that crashed the homepage in production preview.

SmartInvestingPage.jsx (659 lines) is approaching the 700-line threshold — consider extracting InlineApplyForm, STATS/PILLARS/METHOD/TESTIMONIALS/FAQ_ITEMS constants into separate files for maintainability.

Inline apply form's window.open relies on setTimeout 1100ms after async POST — could be flaky if popup blockers see it as non-user-initiated; consider calling window.open synchronously inside the click handler before the await.
seed_data_creation: Posted one TEST lead via inline form: email=test_si@example.com, name=Test User, goal=financial-freedom, source=smart-investing, cta=inline-apply-form
context_for_next_testing_agent: All Smart Investing integration acceptance criteria pass after fixing FeaturedFinancialSection crash. Inline form POSTs to /api/leads correctly and window.open is invoked with https://wealth-unlock-3.emergent.host/. Hero primary CTA + Final CTA both open the keystone-onboarding modal (testid keystone-onboarding). Redirects (/category/smart-investing and /product/keystone-investors-club) both land on /smart-investing as expected. Other 4 categories load CategoryPage normally.
rca of the issue: FeaturedFinancialSection.jsx line 42 had `const { openOnboarding } = useKeystoneOnboarding();` left over from a previous version where CTAs called the modal directly. During the refactor to internal SPA Links, the destructure line was not removed and the import for useKeystoneOnboarding was correctly dropped — leaving an undefined reference. The error only manifested when the component rendered (homepage), throwing ReferenceError and triggering the React error overlay, blanking the homepage. Mitigation applied: removed the dead line. Long-term: ESLint no-undef in CI.
